text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho.
The discord within No Reason's camp had become a major topic of discussion...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around watched with bated breath
to see what the outcome would be.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like they were arguing right up to the very last minute...
Over whether to run in this Kikuka Sho or not."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... the fact that you showed up
means you're motivated, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: There's also a rumor that their adjustments were a total mess because she couldn't get on the same page with her Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer side hasn't given
any comment either, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chose not to say much, either.
For now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I simply follow the secret pact.
Just as I agreed with No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, No Reason-chan...
I wonder what kind of girl she is...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they made up with their trainer.
Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey... No Reason,
to be totally honest... how're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my condition, you ask?
It goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—It is the absolute worst.
And all thanks to a certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Eeeh...? Then making up is still..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I don't care about that blockhead!
I don't care, I don't care, I don't care!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I wasn't keen
on running in this Kikuka Sho in the first place.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Never have I run in a race so bereft of thrill. We are... well and truly finished.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"You may contest the final crown
amongst yourselves as you please."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Race however I want, huh... Then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason poured out
her innermost feelings to those around her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: It looks like you don't really have any intention of winning.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Yes, neither Gimlet nor Kris S is here.
So I thought No Reason was the top contender, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Looks like we'll need to rethink our strategy from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, I am worried, but... this isn't the time for that."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The race is about to start!
I want to show everyone what I'm capable of, in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intentions of the Umamusume shift all at once.
No Reason, thought to be out of form, is no longer marked by the others—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll completely vanish from their sight.
Making them think "No Reason is nothing to fear."
